verdict.rationale: Whether a product's own source is available under an open license is a fair question for an AI app-builder SaaS, so the axis applies. The pack contains no evidence that Lovable's own source code is published or openly licensed. The docs only show that users can browse and download the code Lovable generates for their own projects, which is a different capability, and the note that the backend builds on Supabase's open-source foundation describes an underlying platform, not Lovable's own source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
